query:
SELECT 
  DATE(saleDate) as date,
  saleType,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  SUM(finalAmount) as totalAmount
FROM sales 
WHERE DATE(saleDate) = '2024-12-31'
  AND status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY DATE(saleDate), saleType
ORDER BY saleType
